title: Music of Niger - Wikipedia
text: May 2, 2026 - The Music of Niger has developed from the musical traditions of a mix of ethnic groups: Hausa, the Zarma–Songhai, Tuareg, Fula, Kanuri, Toubou, Diffa Arabs and Gurma, as well as the Boudouma from Lake Chad.
